facts.fact: SPIN states the 196 km Lambarene-Mouila fibre section, first segment of phase 1 of the national backbone extension, was commissioned on 6 October 2026, connecting Fougamou and Mouila to the national network.

systems.owner: SPIN (asset company); Lambarene-Mouila section prefinanced by Moov Africa Gabon Telecom, ceded to Gabon Fiber
